summary: A legislator has to explain why buying a drink still costs extra after the refund is repealed.
realLife: Delaware’s 2010 act replaced the refundable deposit with a temporary fee to finance universal recycling.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: effective date and refundable or nonrefundable charge.

turns.what: Under a deposit, the shopper can recover the charge on an eligible empty.
turns.pulledBy: The purchase is covered by an active refundable deposit.
turns.writesBack: The register records a refundable charge.

turns.what: Under Delaware’s replacement fee, the proceeds support recycling and the shopper has no refund claim for the new charge.
turns.pulledBy: The replacement fee took effect before the purchase.
turns.writesBack: The new charge goes to the fee account.
